What is a Color & Graphic Design Intern?
This design intern will focus on supporting the current Decathlon Design Team for Color and Graphic and (textile and footwear). They should be in tune with the sport consumer trends of China, especially conscious of color and graphics. The design intern will support the team but can also lead with their own projects.

Responsibilities:
COLOR & GRAPHICS
• Create color and graphic proposals for seasonal collections
• Support textile and footwear graphic applications
• Prepare design presentation materials for reviews

Skills:
• Strong sense of color and typography
• Familiar with Adobe Illustrator / Photoshop
• Passionate about sports and design

Requirements:
• Currently enrolled in design-related major
• Available 3-4 days per week for 4+ months
• Good communication in English and Mandarin
